messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up for the missing-spans + bad-aggregation incident on 2026-03-10. Need clear owners and timelines so this doesn't keep popping up. Doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-10-spans-agg
ajay: ack. can we list action items here and assign owners?
kevin: I can take the aggregator precision fix (root cause was the partial key join on nightly rollups). ETA 10 business days? :thinking_face:
ella: I can own the ETL lag/backfill story — need help defining the backfill window and safety limits.
maria: thanks. core items from the postmortem we need to close: 1) instrument span sampling check 2) fix aggregator join key 3) backfill missing spans for last 7 days 4) add recurring check + alert 5) add regression test in CI.
sam: tagging the runbook step: add a daily health check job that computes span coverage delta per service. propose a cron job: `0 */6 * * *` (every 6h) to catch drift earlier.
ajay: suggested quick SQL we can use to detect missing spans (put in alerts):
```
-- rough span coverage check
SELECT service, count(*) as total_spans, count(DISTINCT trace_id) as traces
FROM spans
WHERE ingested_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY total_spans DESC;
```
ella: for the backfill, we should cap to 72h per run to avoid DB pressure. backfill job name: `spans.backfill.v2`. also need a dry-run mode.
kevin: aggregator change: I'll submit a PR with the corrected join + unit tests. will include before/after metrics in the PR description.
maria: owners + ETA summary: kevin -> aggregator fix (10d), ella -> backfill + dry-run (5d to safe test, 14d to full backfill), maria -> runbook + alerting (3d), ajay -> CI regression test + rollout (4d). can everyone confirm?
ajay: confirm. i'll add CI test and wire up alerts to #incidents and paging.
sam: ops note: deploy-bot registered the rollback policy during the incident — keeping it. will add a post-deploy smoke that asserts span counts don't drop > 20% vs baseline.
deploy-bot: deploy recorded: service=aggregator rolling-update v2.3.4 by kevin at 2026-03-10T15:02Z (auto-rollback=enabled)
maria: recurring pattern note — similar span-loss showed up in Oct and Jan. we should add a quarterly audit to verify aggregator key assumptions. propose a 3-month cadence on a calendar invite.
ella: agree. I'll create the calendar and invite owners + infra.
kevin: I'll open the PR this afternoon and tag @maria for rollout approval.
maria: final: i'll update the postmortem with these owners and timestamps, create the runbook section "span-sampling-check" and add the SQL + backfill play. i'll mark items as P1 and tag in the remediation tracker. ping me if timelines need adjustment. :thumbsup:
